scenario: Canvas node movement persists at the terminal change boundary rather than on every drag frame.
input: A stream of position changes from one node drag followed by its terminal drag event.
visibleError: No user-facing error is expected; the contract observes persistence only after the terminal change.
recovery: There is no recovery action because intermediate frames are intentionally not persisted.
sideEffects: The project snapshot and history write once for the completed interaction rather than once per position frame.
